how_to_apply: Applications will be accepted only through Registered Post or Speed Post; applications submitted in person or through any other medium will not be considered.
Download the prescribed application form from the official district website, www.balodabazar.gov.in.
Fill in all the required fields carefully and completely in the prescribed format.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph, attested by a gazetted officer or self-attested, at the designated place on the form.
Self-attest all supporting documents and arrange them in the prescribed order mentioned above.
Clearly mention your name, post applied for, and the name of the programme (NHM/NUHM/RBSK/NRC, etc.) on top of the application and the envelope.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form for each post.

Send the completed application by Registered Post/Speed Post to the Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District Balodabazar (Chhattisgarh), so that it reaches on or before 07 September 2026, 5:30 PM.
important_instructions: All information entered in the application form must match the original documents; incomplete or incorrect applications will be rejected at any stage of selection. Candidates must personally appear for document verification; failure to appear will be treated as a lack of interest, and the candidate will be excluded from the recruitment process. No travel allowance will be paid to candidates for appearing at any stage of the selection process, and being called for any stage does not guarantee selection. Selection to the post does not automatically confer the right to appointment; final appointment depends on actual availability of vacancies and other required procedures/criteria. All appointments will be purely temporary, transferable, and valid up to 31 March 2027 for the current financial year. Candidates whose services were previously terminated by NHM or a government/semi-government department due to indiscipline, financial irregularity, or misconduct will be treated as ineligible. If any discrepancy is found between the information filled in the application and the original documents at any stage, the candidature may be cancelled at any point of the selection process. All appointments and the selection process are subject to the final orders of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in SLP (C) No. 19668/2022. Reservation will be applied as per the roster system prevalent in the district. No separate individual intimation will be sent to candidates; they are advised to regularly check the official district website for updates related to this recruitment.

Candidates with qualifications ranging from 8th pass and 10th/12th pass to nursing, pharmacy, paramedical, AYUSH, physiotherapy, management and postgraduate qualifications can also explore more Chhattisgarh Government Jobs and NHM Government Jobs available across India. content_sections.heading: CMHO Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer (CMHO), District Balodabazar, Chhattisgarh, has officially released the recruitment notification dated 19 August 2026 for filling 38 contractual vacancies under NHM, NUHM, RBSK, AAM/HWC and NRC programmes. The notification includes complete details on post-wise and category-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age limits, salary, selection process, experience criteria, required documents, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification carefully before applying. The notification is available on the official Balodabazar district website. rows.details: Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer (CMHO), District Balodabazar , Chhattisgarh
National Health Mission (NHM) / National Urban Health Mission (NUHM)

content_sections.heading: CMHO Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep note of the following important dates related to this recruitment drive. Applications received after the last date, or through any medium other than Registered/Speed Post, will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: CMHO Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 38 vacancies have been announced across 19 different posts under NHM, NUHM, RBSK, AAM/HWC and NRC programmes. The post-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup is given below. Note: The number of advertised contractual posts is variable. The recruiting authority may increase, decrease, or cancel any notified vacancy for administrative reasons.

content_sections.heading: Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be local residents of Chhattisgarh state and must submit a residence certificate issued by a competent authority. Candidates must possess a valid live registration certificate from the district employment office. Candidates must hold the specific educational qualification prescribed for the post applied for (see the table below). Candidates must meet the prescribed age limit as on 01 January 2026. Only regular courses recognised by UGC/AICTE and the relevant council will be considered valid; private, open, or distance/correspondence courses are not accepted for any post.

rows.essential_educational_qualification: BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree with registration from a GOI-recognised Ayush, Homio, or Unani Registration Board
BSc Nursing/Post Basic BSc Nursing Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course with live registration in the Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council

rows.post_name: Nursing Officer / Staff Nurse / Nursing Officer-UHWC
rows.essential_educational_qualification: BSc Nursing or GNM Course passed with live registration in the Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council
Degree or Diploma in Pharmacy (minimum 50%) with registration in the Pharmacy Registration Council
12th passed with DMLT/BMLT/Paramedical Course in Pathology, registered with the CG Paramedical Council
12th passed with ANM course from an INC-affiliated training centre and live registration
Matriculation from a recognised board (experience in a Government dental college/clinic preferred)
PG Degree/Diploma in Psychology, Counselling, Health Education, Mass Communication, or Social Science
Higher Secondary (10+2) with Biology, plus a 1-year diploma in Multipurpose Worker Training recognised by the state government
12th passed with at least a 1-year Diploma in Computer Applications

content_sections.heading: CMHO Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be reckoned as on 01 January 2026, and the 8th/10th mark sheet will be the only valid proof of date of birth. Medical posts: Minimum 18 years and maximum 70 years. Managerial posts: Minimum 18 years and maximum 64 years. Community Health Officer: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years, with a 5-year age relaxation for local residents of Chhattisgarh (i.e., up to 40 years). Applicable government rules for age relaxation for reserved categories will apply, but in no case shall the maximum age limit, after all relaxations, exceed 45 years. Candidates already working in government/semi-government service will get age relaxation as per prevailing government rules.

content_sections.heading: CMHO Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Post-wise consolidated monthly remuneration ranges from ₹8,800 to ₹26,000 depending on the post (see the vacancy table above for exact figures against each post). Community Health Officer: ₹16,500 per month as consolidated honorarium, along with a Performance-Based Incentive of up to ₹15,000 per month, as per guidelines issued from time to time by the Mission Director, National Health Mission.

content_sections.heading: CMHO Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made by the District Level Selection Committee, National Health Mission, Balodabazar , purely on a merit basis. No written examination or interview is mentioned in the notification. The merit list will be prepared as follows: Serial No. 8 (Laboratory Technician), 10 (2nd ANM), 17 (MPW-Male), and 18 (Jr. Secretarial Assistant-LDC): 40% weightage of 12th class marks + 45% weightage of the relevant technical course marks + experience marks. Serial No. 1 (Block Programme Manager): 65% weightage of educational qualification marks + 20% weightage of computer qualification marks + experience marks. All remaining posts: 85% weightage of educational qualification marks + experience marks. In case of a tie in marks for any post, the candidate with the earlier date of birth (i.e., the older candidate) will be given preference. Experience marks: 2 marks per year (maximum 10 marks for 5 years) for government/semi-government department experience; 3 marks per year (maximum 15 marks for 5 years) for experience under the National Health Mission; for Nursing Officer, Staff Nurse, and ANM posts, 4 marks per year (maximum 20 marks) for ANM/GNM/Nursing-trained midwife candidates. Experience of less than 1 continuous year will not be counted. A one-time bonus of 10 experience marks is available to temporary health workers who served during the COVID-19 pandemic for at least 6 months in a Chhattisgarh government health institution, subject to submission of the relevant appointment order. Combined with other experience, the maximum overall experience marks allowed is 15. Document verification will be conducted for shortlisted candidates: 10 times the number of advertised vacancies for posts with 1 to 10 vacancies, and 5 times the number of advertised vacancies for posts with 11 to 50 vacancies. A post-wise waiting list will also be prepared, comprising 300% of the advertised vacancies for each post. The selection list and waiting list will remain valid for 1 year from the date of publication, or until a new recruitment process is completed, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: CMHO Balodabazar Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach self-attested photocopies of the following documents with the application, arranged in this order: Duly filled application form Residence certificate issued by a competent authority Caste certificate issued by a competent authority (if applicable) Live registration certificate from the district employment office Marksheets of all years/semesters of the educational qualification Degree certificate and live registration certificate from the relevant council (if applicable) Experience certificate (if applicable) Identity proof Recent passport-size photograph, self-attested or attested by a gazetted officer, affixed at the specified place on the form For the Community Health Officer post, candidates who completed the Integrated Certificate Course in Community Health along with BSc Nursing/Post Basic BSc Nursing must also submit a course-completion certificate as per the Appendix-I format, signed by the principal of their college.
